author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content:
Hi warga threads!

We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project

Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out.

We're looking for artists that draws
- Anime / manga style illustrations
- Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration
- Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork
- Semi-realistic illustrations
- and any other art styles

Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!
